payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the proposed similarity measure over BM25, quantified by NDCG scores.

claims.text: The proposed similarity measure outperforms BM25 by increasing NDCG@20 by 23%.
NDCG@5 and NDCG@10 also show improvements of 23% and 25% over BM25, respectively.
The proposed method achieves stronger performance than BM25 on TREC and PubMed datasets.
